description: Person A: a young man of about 22 with short wavy dark-brown hair, light olive skin, clean-shaven, wearing a plain black short-sleeve T-shirt. Location A: a warm home kitchen with medium-brown wooden cabinets, a stainless-steel fridge directly behind him, a speckled beige granite countertop in the foreground, a stovetop kettle on the left, a small ceiling spotlight at the top of the frame, warm tungsten light. On the counter in the centre: an enormous footed glass candy jar about 60 cm tall. Close, frontal camera at counter height; he stands behind the counter, very energetic, shouting and laughing.
